_comment: OpenAI — paid key. Copy to llm_config.json.
_security: NEVER put a real key in this file. Paste it in the app's Settings, or export OPENAI_API_KEY.
_setup: 1) Paste your key in Settings (AI provider key) and Save. 2) cp llm_config.openai.json llm_config.json 3) python3 app.py
_model_note: Pick the exact model id from https://platform.openai.com/docs/models — the app sends whatever is written here.
